problems: The violet mist is a thick, opaque solid ring (blob radii up to 0.09) that fills most of the ball and reaches the glass wall. It reads as a solid purple object inside the ball, not as swirling mist, and it hides the clear glass. The floating blob is correct, since mist inside glass floats by design. The fix is a thinner, lighter, multi-turn wisp with a small soft core, kept clear of the glass wall, so the clear glass reads around it.
The prong roots only graze the cup rim. A small gold collar ball where each prong meets the rim would make the joint read as solid.

The violet mist is a fat, round, solid tube that coils through the ball like a snake or a candy twist. The restyle will keep that shape, so it will not read as swirling mist. Make it a thin, flat, wispy swirl: flattened puffs in two curling arms around a tiny core, filling more of the ball but kept clear of the glass.
